name: refactor
description: Architecture rules a repository declares in .claude/architecture.json, enforced at Edit/Write (layer direction, forbidden imports), plus code-smell notes and a refactoring catalog keyed to refactoring.guru

archFile.title: Architecture file
archFile.description: Path, relative to the repository root, of the file that declares layers and allowed imports

arch.title: Enforce architecture
arch.description: Refuse an Edit or Write that adds an import the architecture file forbids

smells.title: Smell notes
smells.description: After an edit, note long functions, long parameter lists, deep nesting, large files and repeated blocks, with the refactoring to apply

stopAudit.title: Audit at stop
stopAudit.description: When a turn ends, check the files changed since HEAD for violations that bypassed Edit/Write (e.g. sed -i), as a note

llmReview.title: Model review at stop
llmReview.description: When a turn ends, have a small model review the diff against the smell catalog, as a note (costs one request per turn with changes)
